fields.description:
Carry the configured implementation budget caps from `Settings` into `DraftPullRequestInput` so `IMPLEMENTATION_MAX_LLM_CALLS`, `IMPLEMENTATION_MAX_TOKENS`, and `IMPLEMENTATION_MAX_COST_USD` govern execution.

At the base commit `cf26c4b`, `TemporalStarter.start` in `services/orchestration/intake_runtime.py` and `_run_via_temporal` in `scripts/demo_draft_pr.py` both construct `DraftPullRequestInput` without `max_cost_usd`, `max_llm_calls`, or `max_tokens`. The dataclass defaults of 5.0 US dollars, 200 LLM calls, and 2000000 tokens therefore apply to every run started through either entry point, and the three settings are read only by the reporting scripts `scripts/cost_rollup.py` and `scripts/reconcile_usage.py`. An operator raising a cap for a large target repository sees no change and the run still terminates at the default.

The workflow already enforces whatever caps it is given. `_budget_breach` compares against `params.max_llm_calls`, `params.max_tokens`, and `params.max_cost_usd`, and a breach ends the run with a terminal reason. The change is to populate those three fields from `BudgetCaps.from_settings`, which is the existing helper that reads the settings, so both entry points and the reporting scripts derive the caps from one place.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Intake carries the configured LLM call cap into the workflow input, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_runtime.py -k intake_carries_the_configured_llm_call_cap`
- [ ] Intake carries the configured token cap into the workflow input, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_runtime.py -k intake_carries_the_configured_token_cap`
- [ ] Intake carries the configured cost cap into the workflow input, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_runtime.py -k intake_carries_the_configured_cost_cap`
- [ ] Intake falls back to the shared default caps when no setting overrides them, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_runtime.py -k intake_falls_back_to_the_default_caps`
- [ ] The demo entry point carries all three configured caps into the workflow input, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_demo_draft_pr_budget.py -k demo_run_carries_the_configured_caps`

## Testing
Run each acceptance criterion selector on its own. Run `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/inv ci` before closing the ticket.
